name: e2e-v0
description: Fixed vocabulary for inventorying end-to-end test automation frameworks before merging them into one. Review and extend; bump 'version' when you do so the affected records are re-run.

capabilities.description: Environments, configuration layering and overrides (files, env vars, run settings)
Credentials and secrets: where they come from and how they reach the tests
Test data sources: files, builders, databases, services
How test data is bound to tests or steps (tables, attributes, injection)
Set-up and clean-up of data through APIs or databases before/after tests
Generated or randomised test data
Sharing state between steps, classes or scenarios (scenario context, DI containers)
Lifecycle hooks: before/after run, feature, scenario, step, test
Parallel execution and thread safety
Selecting what runs: tags, categories, filters, run lists
Retrying failed tests, steps or actions
Assertion style and libraries, soft assertions
Logging during runs
Reports and report portals (HTML, Allure, Extent, TRX, JUnit XML)
Screenshots, video, page source, device logs, network captures on failure
Integration with CI pipelines
Integration with test management or issue tracking
HTTP/API helpers used by the tests
Database access helpers
Email, SMS, OTP or message-queue helpers
File, download and upload helpers
Creating a driver/browser/session: local, remote grid, cloud
Driver reuse, quit, crash recovery, per-test vs per-run sessions
Capabilities and options per browser/device/app
Driver binaries, Appium server, grid or device-farm infrastructure
Locator strategies and how locators are declared
Element wrappers/controls with their own actions
Waits and synchronisation (explicit, implicit, polling, hard sleeps)
Typing, clicking, selecting, keyboard
Touch gestures, scrolling, swiping, drag and drop
Windows, tabs, frames, web views, alerts, native/web context switching
Installing, launching, resetting, backgrounding the app; deep links; permissions
Device or desktop-machine specifics: orientation, settings, clipboard, notifications
Page-object/screen-object base classes and conventions
One page/screen abstraction with an implementation per platform
